name: BEIR: Benchmarking Information Retrieval
description: BEIR is a heterogeneous benchmark for evaluating information retrieval models in a zero-shot setting across 17 diverse datasets covering 9 tasks (fact checking, bio-medical retrieval, question answering, argument retrieval, tweet retrieval, duplicate question retrieval, news retrieval, entity retrieval, and citation prediction).
